name: openpaperdesign
description: Create, open and edit design canvases from the Codex sidebar in an editable canvas in the in-app browser, kept in the app's own local library (paper-rs, local only).

interface.longDescription: The OpenPaperDesign home in the sidebar creates, opens, closes, imports and exports paper-rs canvases kept in the plugin's own data folder, and opens each in an editable canvas in the in-app browser on a loopback URL. No chat message or agent turn is needed for that. Workspace projects (design/<name>/) need a separately started openpaperdesign-mcp --codex-context server. Local only: no cloud, no telemetry. Not affiliated with Paper (paper.design).
